page.text:
These conjectures differ in language but share a methodological lesson.
Definitions and known theorems constrain where a counterexample could
occur; computation and partial results supply evidence; only a proof can
promote the conjecture to a theorem. A future resolution should change
the card's status rather than silently changing the meaning of the
statement.
